paragraphs.source_en: I am in no position to judge him, because I will never fully understand what he went through. However, I do believe that if he were to fully exercise his four human endowments, he, too, would find more peace of mind than he ever thought possible. Yes, our genes, upbringing, and difficulties affect us, but I do not believe they *determine* us.

paragraphs.source_en: Each day, you and I make hundreds of decisions as to whether to be reactive or proactive. On any given day, the weather is bad, you receive a mean text, your boss diminishes you, you get a parking ticket, your friend talks behind your back, you get overlooked for a promotion, your property taxes increase. So, what are you going to do about it?

paragraphs.source_en: Reactive people make choices based on impulse. They’re like a can of soda—when life shakes them up, the pressure builds, and they suddenly explode. Proactive people make choices based on values. They think before they act. They recognize they cannot control everything that happens to them, but they can control what they do about it. Unlike reactive people who are full of carbonation, proactive people are like water. Shake them up all you want—they stay calm, cool, and in control.

paragraphs.source_en: After all that’s been said and written, being proactive comes down to two things. First, take responsibility for your life; and second, take initiative. It’s that simple. Be an agent, not a victim. Don’t wait for life to happen to you; happen to it. Be the driver of your life, not just a passenger. Live out of your imagination, not your past.

paragraphs.source_en: In your mind’s eye, see yourself going to the funeral of a loved one. Picture yourself driving to the funeral parlor or chapel, parking the car, and getting out. As you walk inside the building, you notice the flowers, the soft organ music. You see the faces of friends and family you pass along the way. You feel the shared sorrow of losing, the joy of having known, that radiates from the hearts of the people there.
